hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: Santiago Abascal and Vox leaders have intensified their 29N election campaign, framing immigration into the Canary Islands as a 'planned invasion' and demanding military naval deployment alongside Rwanda-style deportation centers. The party's sharp anti-immigrant focus has triggered fierce public debates, including clashes over media appearances and welfare eligibility.
hotspots.affect: This story drives maximum engagement through intense alarmist framing, existential anti-migrant rhetoric, and high-stakes campaign polarization ahead of the November 29 elections.

hotspots.title: Macron-Le Pen Clash Over Ukraine Aid & 2027
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen and Rassemblement National have launched a detailed 2027 presidential program focused on pension reform and early retirement, alongside continued arguments regarding Ukraine aid and civil society funding. Heated televised exchanges and sharp clashes over state subsidies for advocacy groups have kept the RN at the center of national political debate.
hotspots.affect: The debate generates strong emotional investment by pairing kitchen-table economic promises with explosive accusations of ideological bias in public institutions.

hotspots.title: Javier Milei Ratifies 2027 Reelection Bid
hotspots.blurb: President Javier Milei delivered combative speeches to business executives at the CICyP, attributing market country risk to fear of 'Orcolandia' (peronism) and promising radical structural reform through 2027. Meanwhile, public remarks by Pope Leo XIV urging against violent language and urging care for the poor sparked further political friction.
hotspots.affect: Milei's polarizing rhetoric creates intense affective charge, pitting free-market transformation against opposition forces in a high-stakes ideological battle.

hotspots.title: AfD Nominates Thomas Berthold for Bundespräsident
hotspots.blurb: The AfD's nomination of former football World Cup champion Thomas Berthold for Federal President has drawn sharp condemnation from sports administrators and mainstream party leaders. The nomination is unfolding alongside broader backlash over provocative speeches by state AfD leaders on Volkstrauertag.
hotspots.affect: The story commands high affective attention by weaponizing a public figure to challenge established democratic norms and provoking condemnation across sports and political elites.

hotspots.title: Moraes Bars Allied Visits to Imprisoned Bolsonaro
hotspots.blurb: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes denied requests by key political allies, including Senator Rogério Marinho and Tereza Cristina, to visit Jair Bolsonaro while under home confinement. Bolsonarista leaders denounced the ruling as an arbitrary 'death penalty' on fundamental political rights.
hotspots.affect: The judicial prohibition feeds an intense judicial persecution narrative among supporters, sharpening conflict between Congress and the Supreme Court.
